name: Jinxi Axle Company Limited
summary: Jinxi Axle Company Limited engages in the research, development, and manufacturing of railway vehicles and related accessories, precision forging, and precision casting products in China. The company offers railway equipment, such as axle, railway car, and bogie; integrated urban sewage treatment machine; and perforated grille; waste incineration feeder; and10,000-ton sewage treatment equipment; electric flatbed truck, and circular heating furnace; K6 side frame, K6 Rocking Pillow, SCT side frame, and SCT rocking pillow; and grate bars, scraper, side grate bars, intermediate absorber side plate, end spacers, end grate bars, end casting, and upper cover plate. It also offers defense equipment…
